name: Kameoka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kameoka city emblem in maroon: a stylised angular device with a white disc, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kameoka, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 6 April 1955.

features.role: Kameoka city emblem — a stylised angular device with a white disc, like a stylised character
